headline: Bitcoin Options Skew Widens To 46.54 Points From 22.2 Ahead Of The October 24 Expiry
narrative: Bitcoin options skew widened to 46.54 volatility points from 22.2, which means the October 24 put struck at 73,000 is priced 46.54 points above the October 24 call struck at 89,000. The put marked 95.46 implied volatility and the call marked 48.92, so money in this pipe is paying for protection under 73,000 rather than for a move through 89,000. The prior print on the same strikes and the same expiry carried a 22.2 point gap, which means the premium for downside insurance has widened.
author: jordan
